plate: Locked orthographic camera, fixed anatomical scale and centred body. Keep the full crest, the whole sword, the whole shield, limbs and boots within frame. Only the body moves; nothing else appears in the frame.

defend_h3_v1.action: Crouch behind the tall kite shield, setting it forward in front of the body with the helmet lowered behind its rim and the sword held low, then hold the braced guard on both planted boots. No attack and no return to the relaxed stance.

cast_h3_v1.action: A knightly salute. The knight raises the crystal sword upright in front of the visor, the shield held steady, holds the salute briefly, then lowers the blade back to the original stance. A physical gesture only: no spell, glow or aura.

death_h3_v1.action: Collapse slowly and heavily. The knight sinks onto both knees leaning on the shield, stays kneeling a moment, then topples forward and lies flat, finishing motionless with the helmet at screen left, the shield lying across the body and the sword on the ground beside it. The body never leaves the ground; no recovery, no floating equipment and no disappearing body.
